title: Prepare nearby RAW previews for smoother culling
notes: Prepare a bounded window of RAW-rendered culling previews around the selected photo, cancel obsolete navigation work, retain recently viewed previews, and open cached RAWs without a camera-JPEG flash. Keep first-visit JPEGs instant, align their known frame and crossfade to the RAW over 150 ms. Filmstrip previews and processing defaults stay unchanged. Fixes the geometry/preview-handoff portion of #309; brightness is tracked separately in #334.
